Hubble finds phantom objects near dead quasars

Keel said that one possible explanation is that pairs of co-orbiting black holes are powering the quasars, and this could change their brightness, like using the dimmer switch on a chandelier.

How do black holes power things?

With their gravity, the thing they have in abundance. Typically stuff falling towards black holes will emit light:

http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quasar

The energy emitted by a quasar derives from mass falling onto the accretion disc around the black hole.

If two black holes are orbiting each other, there would presumably be variation in the accretion disk(s) that corresponds to their period.
